scope: Isolated PBF alternatives; no production changes or cost measurements until combined admission.
raw_storage: Per-request immutable files under this repository evidence directory, outside temporary storage; gzip raw complete scheduled observations, fsync and SHA256 after each run; mirror final package to PC home durable directory.

ballistic.COM_error_bound: 0.5*g*T*dt + 1e-8 (semi-implicit Euler), internal horizontal COM drift <= 1e-8 m

model_ladder: static volumetric wall density and its fixed-particle gradient (one change)
true Poly6 gradient replacing Spiky (one change)
independent timestep/iteration sweeps on fixed model
classification: Bulk and surface diagnostics use analytical tank height H=M/(rho*A), not a density-threshold label. Signed and compression-only errors both retained. Wall region distance<h; free-surface region y>H-h.
unqualified: Pressure-field CFD accuracy, surface tension, turbulent velocity validation, curved/moving walls and production API semantics.
